title: Excubia push envelope
description: Protocol version 1 of the body that excubia push sends to POST {appUrl}/api/reports with Authorization: Bearer <project token>. The app stores a repeated batchId once. Runtime batches (php artisan excubia:push-runtime) use the same protocol version with type runtime and a runtime payload instead of report, sent to POST {appUrl}/api/runtime: see $defs.runtimeEnvelope and docs/runtime-schema.json. Frozen at 1.0.0.

batchId.description: Random UUID version 4, new for every run (report) or every claimed buffer (runtime). A retry of the same send keeps it.

sentAt.description: UTC time the body was built for sending, Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z.

runtimeEnvelope.description: Body of POST {appUrl}/api/runtime. A batch the app did not acknowledge with 2xx is sent again with the same batchId.
